result.summary: Found 1 issue: a missing or broken image in the 'Popular right now' section that displays a generic placeholder icon instead of actual restaurant content.

issues.description: The first restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section shows a gray image placeholder icon instead of the restaurant's actual image or photo. This suggests the image failed to load or is missing.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the restaurant image loads properly or provide a fallback image. If this is a loading state, add a loading spinner instead of the generic placeholder icon.
